Goldy Luck and the Three Pandas by Natasha Yim - Lunar or Chinese New Year Read Aloud Storybook For Kids - Goldilocks Fairytale Retelling
To keep hearing great stories, subscribe here: https://bit.ly/sub2freshreading

Goldy's parents thought she would be lucky when she was born, but she is a bit clumsy. It's Lunar New Year, and she is sent over to her the Changs' house to give them some turnip cakes to celebrate. When she arrives, the panda family isn't home and calamity ensues. This is a great multicultural retelling of the classic Goldilocks story!
